order.rule: remove duplicated (date, zone) rows, keep last export
outage/invalid: production <= 0 kWh or PR missing or Yf < 0.5 h
commissioning: date < 2023-04-26 excluded from trend/event analyses
reported PR >= 89.95 % treated as truncated; own-sensor insolation H_i only on untruncated days
common-reference metrics: exclude H3 < 1 kWh/m2 and PRc outside 0.3-1.2
no imputation; statistics on available days
sensitivity: clear days only, H3 >= 3 kWh/m2

event_windows: pre = d-14..d-1, gap = d0..d+3, post = d+4..d+17 (primary); sensitivity windows 7/14/21/28 d and gaps 1/3/5 d
